name: TrussCraft
description: Timber roof trusses in BimCraft, PartCraft, ModelCraft and CadCraft: common, hip, girder with jacks and valley sets from a roof outline; cut, joint and stock lists; a jig layout drawn 1:1; your own loads, combinations, plate and species tables; a first member check in Problems. Not a substitute for engineered truss design or manufacturer sign-off.
author: CadCraft
